show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Michael Batnick - The Best Investors and Their Biggest Mistakes (Capital Allocators, EP.71)
summary:
This show is an open exploration of the people and process behind capital allocation. Like, none of these
mistakes were because somebody used too aggressive of a growth of something. So how do we come up with a portfolio
that will de-risk in the event?
